link_notes: Repo is the general OpenDP SmartNoise SDK (many synthesizers), not clearly the DP-CTGAN paper's own code; paper text unavailable (TLDR only), so verdicts are thin.

open_release.rationale: The SDK generates differentially private synthetic data and the DPCTGAN docs describe DP-SGD training, a formal privacy guarantee.

quotes.text: The SmartNoise SDK includes 2 packages: * [smartnoise-sql](sql/): Run differentially private SQL queries * [smartnoise-synth](synth/): Generate differentially private synthetic data
Conditional tabular GAN with differentially private stochastic gradient descent.

pipeline_testing.rationale: Neither the TLDR, README nor docs mention test or development data.

ml_augmentation.rationale: No paper full text, and the README and docs show no ML utility evaluation.

statistical_replication.rationale: No paper full text, and the README and docs show no fidelity evaluation.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal or DAG framing in the TLDR, README or docs.

education.rationale: The README is install and example code for a toolkit, with no teaching framing.

benchmarking.rationale: The SDK lists DP-CTGAN among several synthesizers, but nothing shows it used as a baseline or benchmark.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No paper full text, and nothing in the README or docs mentions class imbalance.
